Title: Procession Checkpoints
Rule: Unauthorized passage along the planned procession route requires bypassing Order checkpoints.

Title: Procession Secured
Rule: Armed Order guards control approaches to the Procession.

Title: Procession Blockade
Rule: The occupied route cannot be used without negotiation, dispersal or alternate approach.

Title: Dawn Poster Campaign
Rule: Dawn campaign posters cover the Colony, giving residents clear organizing contacts and public meeting notices.

Title: Cult Procession Access
Rule: Cult attendants may accompany the upcoming Keeper Procession.

Title: House Custody Dispute
Rule: Cult attendants demand custody of House of Abiding; its access may be contested in play.

Title: Witness Specimen
Rule: Witnesses offer supervised examination of the Unclaimed Object at the Hall.

Title: Pilgrims Rest Incursion
Rule: An active Veiled incursion affects Pilgrim's Rest and may require containment.

Title: Cult Registry Pattern
Rule: New Cult-related Veiled incursions gain +1 Class (stacks with Cult Ledger Relationships; max Class V; not retroactive).

Title: Cult Ledger Relationships
Rule: New Cult-related Veiled incursions gain +1 Class (stacks with Cult Registry Pattern; max Class V; not retroactive).

Title: Pilgrims Gifts
Rule: Maelyn can offer gifts from surrendered possessions.

Title: Registry Arrangement
Rule: Perrik can provide services connecting Cult-related surrendered property to the Claims Registry.

Title: Public Access to the Book
Rule: Dawn makes the Book available for public inspection, without automatically identifying the people named.

Title: Public Works Funded
Rule: Dawn controls the Civic Improvement Fund and it is neither Contested nor Destroyed: Dawn-funded projects proceed.

Title: Public Works Disrupted
Rule: New Dawn-funded projects cannot begin; existing work pauses unless refinanced.

Title: Order Excluded
Rule: Order officials cannot enter Assembly Hall as authorities without a Dawn invitation.

Title: The Record Corrected
Rule: Witness-authenticated historical accounts appear on broadsides covering or accompanying Dawn posters, and remain usable as evidence.

Title: Displaced Administration
Rule: Dawn occupies the civic offices; Order administrators operate elsewhere or regain access.

Title: Cache Looting
Rule: Newly discovered caches hold loot on Stable 4–6; Contested 5–6; Damaged 6 only; Destroyed none (d6).

Title: Remembrance Disrupted
Rule: Witnesses cannot use the Empty Lectern for customary rites; must find an alternative.

Title: Bell Unreliable / Silent
Rule: If Damaged, ringing unreliable; if Destroyed, no civic ringing from this Bell.

Title: Civic Alarm Lost
Rule: Loss of the Colony's familiar civic alarm increases public unease.

Title: Supplies Confiscated
Rule: The Shattered cannot draw equipment and consumables from the confiscated network.
